fact: As updated on 29 June 2026, the WAEMU Banking Commission's register lists one payment institution (Intouch Guinée-Bissau, EP.GB.001/2025) and one e-money institution (Finances Mobiles Bissau, EME.GB.021/2023) licensed for Guinea-Bissau.
title: Liste des établissements de paiement et de monnaie électronique - Guinée-Bissau
